summary: Rename or redirect collection plugins with a redirect entry in meta/runtime.yml using the new FQCN, optionally adding deprecation; Ansible 2.9 ignores runtime.yml, so use symlinks there, though 2.10+ prefers runtime.yml.
questions: How do I rename a module in my collection without breaking users?
How do I redirect a module to a different collection?
Does a redirect need the FQCN even within the same collection?
How do I rename modules for Ansible 2.9 users?

answer_card.title: Rename or redirect plugins in a collection
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
plugin_routing:
  modules:
    old_cloud:
      redirect: foo.bar.new_cloud
      deprecation:
        removal_version: 2.0.0
        warning_text: Use foo.bar.new_cloud instead.
```
Always use the **FQCN** of the target, even in the same collection. Ansible 2.9 doesn't read `meta/runtime.yml`; use symlinks there. ansible-base 2.10+ prefers `runtime.yml` over symlinks.
